# Kynov — Next-Gen Agile Engine & Sprint Tracker

> High-performance Agile velocity engine, sprint tracking workspace, and multi-tenant project governance running on Cloudflare Edge.

## Overview
Kynov is a modern alternative to Atlassian Jira and Linear built for high-output engineering teams. It provides sub-50ms Kanban board interactions, live sprint backlogs, velocity sparklines, multi-tenant organization workspaces, and Git PR tracking.

## Core Capabilities
- **Sub-50ms Board Latency**: Optimistic state updates and distributed Cloudflare D1 persistence.
- **Sprint & Backlog Planning**: Velocity tracking, point estimation, and burndown analytics.
- **Multi-Tenant Corporate Governance**: Complete tenant isolation, granular RBAC, and multi-project support.
- **Integrated Knowledge Base**: Built-in architecture decision records (ADRs), PRDs, and team runbooks.
